{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "apoelstra",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "pointed out that codex32 seeds are unencrypted and bypass wallet passphrases"
    },
    {
      "login": "Sjors",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "argued key material import/export should use addhdkey/gethdkeys and must account for descriptors"
    },
    {
      "login": "BenWestgate",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "pointed out missing timestamps for rescans and urged support for share sets and descriptors"
    },
    {
      "login": "rkrux",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK for introducing paper-based wallet backups"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:3108925454",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "a raw codex32 seed allows an attacker to sweep funds without needing the wallet passphrase",
      "quote": "the seed is the seed -- once an attacker has it, it's game over. He doesn't need the passphrase or any other part of the wallet to sweep coins",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3109229857",
        "c:3109330016"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "c:3109229857",
      "settled_by_quote": "Yes, you're right. I thought the passphrase deterministically modified the seed to create the BIP 32 Extended Key, but that's not the case."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3116588223",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "backing up raw keys in custom seed RPCs bypasses descriptor backups needed for complex wallets and fragments key import logic away from addhdkey",
      "quote": "It seems to me that codex32 only plays a role in (1). And so importing it should be done with `addhdkey`. Exporting could be done with `gethdkeys`.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3396349582",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "restoring solely from seed lacks wallet birth timestamps needed for efficient rescanning and lacks descriptor associations",
      "quote": "we need the timestamp no? Other approaches made the import/restore command require a corresponding descriptor to function and that seems more robust for existing wallets.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4206994281",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "paper-based backups are a ubiquitous industry standard and timely now that legacy wallets are removed",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial record for the POC PR. Reviewers support the concept of paper backups in principle, but open objections remain regarding the architecture: Sjors and BenWestgate noted that seed recovery without descriptors and birth timestamps is incomplete for modern descriptor wallets, and Sjors prefers integration via addhdkey."
}
